metadata.description: Laser-cut board games from one prompt: the boardgame-create skill and its fable reviewer, on the boardgame-engine.

plugins.name: boardgame-create
plugins.description: Design and fully produce a laser-cut board game from one prompt: rules engine and self-play, kerf-compensated cut files, the shoulder box with its glue jig, a 3D page that opens the box and plays the game, and the print rulebook. Clones the boardgame-engine as the game's submodule.
